mf.title: Google Merchant feed
mf.sub: Your products as a feed for Google Merchant Center: free listings first, Shopping ads only if you choose them there.
mf.off: The feed is off: its address answers “not found”. Below is what it would hold; switch it on in its card.
mf.readOnly: You can see this page. Changing its card needs the permission to manage campaigns.
mf.addressSub: In Merchant Center: Products › Feeds › add a feed › Scheduled fetch, and paste this address. No key is needed; nothing is sent from the shop.
mf.noAddress: The address shows once the shop's own domain is set (it answers only there).
mf.r_soldOut: Sold out (left out by the card): {n}
mf.sampleSub: The best-ranked products first, as the feed lists them.
mf.empty: No published product in a shown category yet.
mf.cardText: On: the feed answers at its address on the shop's own domain. No ad spend starts from here.
mf.how1: Switch the feed on and add its address in Merchant Center as a scheduled fetch.
mf.how2: Set Bangladesh as the target country there, with free listings on.
mf.how3: After two weeks, write down in Merchant Center's notes how many products were approved and shown.
mf.how4: Shopping ads only if Google offers them for Bangladesh — and only with the owner's written OK for any budget.
